title: C.J. Stroud on reuniting with Marvin Harrison Jr.: It's perfect for him

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: C.J. Stroud on reuniting with Marvin Harrison Jr.: It's perfect for him
sources.description: Coach DeMeco Ryans twice declined to answer questions about whether the Texans had completed a trade with the Cardinals for wide receiver Marvin Harrison Jr.
